Load configuration files
- location of model drivers, rds files (containing models), tables of parameter estimates and performance metrics, and figures. 

```{r}
read_properties <- function(file_path) {
  lines <- readLines(file_path)
  lines <- lines[grepl("=", lines)]  # only keep lines with key-value pairs
  key_vals <- strsplit(lines, "=")
  props <- setNames(
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 2)),
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 1))
  )
  return(props)
}

# *** paleo_config.properties must be in Paleo_Lightning_Fire_Uden_2026
#location of this script:
current_path <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
#get path to this project
base_path <- sub("(.*Paleo_Lightning_Fire_Uden_2026).*", "\\1", current_path)
#open 
config <- read_properties(file.path(base_path, "paleo_config.properties"))

# Extract values from config
drivers_root <- config[["drivers_root"]]
rds_root <- config[["rds_root"]]
table_root <- config[["table_root"]]
predictions_root <- config[["predictions_root"]]
mu_sigma_root <- config[["mu_sigma_root"]]
performance_root <- config[["performance_root"]]
figure_root <- config[["figure_root"]]
fire_data_root <- config[["fire_data_root"]]
paleoclimate_data_root <- config[["paleoclimate_data_root"]]
era5_data_root <- config[["era5_data_root"]]
proximity_data_root <- config[["proximity_data_root"]]
```

```{r}
df_paleo <- fread(file.path(base_path, "Paleo_Reconstructions/predictions_paleo_posterior_no_outliers_cap.csv"))
```

Strike rate
Plot total 10 year strike count and compare with modern 10 year total:
```{r}

ggplot(df_modern, aes(x=r_strike_obs)) + geom_density() + ggtitle("observed 2002-2011")
ggplot(df_modern, aes(x=r_strike)) + geom_density() + ggtitle("predicted 2002-2011")
ggplot(df_paleo, aes(x=r_strike)) + geom_density() + ggtitle("predicted paleo")

var_paleo <-  "r_strike"
y_lable <- "Strike rate" 
main <- "(a)"

#get 10 year total for modern period
modern_total <- sum(df_modern$r_strike_obs) 
#modern_total_area_diff <- modern_total * area_diff
modern_predicted_total <- sum(df_modern$r_strike)  

#collapse to one Alaska-wide total per summer (year), sum across all gridcells and all three summer months.
df_year <- df_paleo %>%
  dplyr::select(year, r_strike) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(annual_total = sum(r_strike, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

#sum across 10 year bins
df_summary <- df_year %>%
  mutate(decade_bin = floor(year / 10) * 10) %>%
  group_by(decade_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    decade_total      = sum(annual_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df_summary, aes(x = as.factor(decade_bin), y = decade_total),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(seq(min(df_summary$decade_bin),
                                              max(df_summary$decade_bin), by = 500))) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = scales::breaks_log(n = 5), labels = scales::label_number()) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = modern_total, color = "2002-2011 observed"),  # Horizontal line
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1) +
  # geom_hline(
  #   aes(yintercept = modern_total_area_diff, color = "2002-2011 observed area differnece"), 
  #   linetype = "dashed",
  #   linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = modern_predicted_total, color = "2002-2011 predicted"), 
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Year (10-yr bin)", y = y_lable,
       title = main, color = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
p1
```

Strike count
Plot total 10 year strike count and compare with modern 10 year total:
```{r}
var_paleo <-  "n_strikes"
y_lable <- "Strike count" 
main <- "(a)"

#get 10 year total for modern period
modern_total <- sum(df_modern$n_strikes_obs) 
modern_mean <- mean(df_modern$n_strikes_obs) 
modern_median <- median(df_modern$n_strikes_obs) 
modern_max <- max(df_modern$n_strikes_obs) 
modern_min <- min(df_modern$n_strikes_obs) 
#modern_total_area_diff <- modern_total * area_diff

#collapse to one Alaska-wide total per summer (year), sum across all gridcells and all three summer months.
df_year <- df_paleo %>%
  dplyr::select(year, n_strikes) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(annual_total = sum(n_strikes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

#sum across 10 year bins
df_summary <- df_year %>%
  mutate(decade_bin = floor(year / 10) * 10) %>%
  group_by(decade_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    decade_total      = sum(annual_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    decade_mean      = mean(annual_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    decade_median      = median(annual_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    decade_max      = max(annual_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    decade_min      = min(annual_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

df_long <- df_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(decade_bin, decade_total, decade_mean, decade_median, decade_max, decade_min) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(decade_total, decade_mean, decade_median, decade_max, decade_min),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )

p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df_long, aes(x = as.factor(decade_bin), y = value, color = metric),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(seq(min(df_summary$decade_bin),
                                              max(df_summary$decade_bin), by = 500))) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = scales::breaks_log(n = 5), labels = scales::label_number()) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = modern_total, color = "2002-2011 total"),  # Horizontal line
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = modern_mean, color = "2002-2011 mean"),  # Horizontal line
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1) +
      geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = modern_median, color = "2002-2011 median"),  # Horizontal line
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1) +
        geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = modern_max, color = "2002-2011 maximum"),  # Horizontal line
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1) +
          geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = modern_min, color = "2002-2011 minimum"),  # Horizontal line
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1) +
  # geom_hline(
  #   aes(yintercept = modern_total_area_diff, color = "2002-2011 area differnece"), 
  #   linetype = "dashed",
  #   linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Year (10-yr bin)", y = y_lable,
       title = main, color = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
p1


p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = filter(df_summary, decade_bin > 1900), aes(x = as.factor(decade_bin), y = decade_total),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(seq(min(df_summary$decade_bin),
                                              max(df_summary$decade_bin), by = 500))) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = scales::breaks_log(n = 5), labels = scales::label_number()) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = modern_total, color = "2002-2011"),  # Horizontal line
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1) +
  # geom_hline(
  #   aes(yintercept = modern_total_area_diff, color = "2002-2011 area differnece"), 
  #   linetype = "dashed",
  #   linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Year (10-yr bin)", y = y_lable,
       title = main, color = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
```
